body:
# ⚡ Random Events

**Every minute, something happens. Good or bad — you never know.**

Random Events is a Fabric server-side mod that periodically triggers random events for all players on the server. Some events will help you, others will ruin your day. Stay alert!

---

## ✨ Features

- **20 unique events** — 10 good, 10 bad
- **Countdown HUD** displayed in the top-right corner *(client mod optional)*
- **Fully configurable** via in-game YACL config screen (ModMenu required)
- **Translatable** — supports English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese
- **Multiplayer-ready** — events fire for all players simultaneously

---

## 🟢 Good Events

| Event | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| Healing Rain | Restores all players to full health |
| Food Drop | Drops cooked food from the sky |
| Speed Boost | Grants Speed II for 30 seconds |
| XP Rain | Rains experience orbs |
| Lucky Minute | Applies Luck II effect |
| Teleport Chaos | Randomly teleports all players |
| Item Magnet | Pulls nearby dropped items into your inventory |
| Bouncy | Grants Jump Boost V and Slow Falling |
| Fireworks Party | Launches fireworks particles and sounds |
| Mystery Potion | Applies a random positive potion effect |

## 🔴 Bad Events

| Event | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| Lightning Storm | Strikes 5 lightning bolts near players |
| Sudden Hunger | Drains food bar to almost empty |
| Total Darkness | Inflicts Blindness and Darkness with Warden sounds |
| Zombie Swarm | Spawns 5 zombies near each player |
| Disoriented | Applies Nausea and Slowness |
| Position Swap | Swaps all players' positions |
| Anvil Rain | Drops 3 anvils from the sky |
| Low Gravity | Sends players floating with Levitation |
| Web Trap | Surrounds players with cobwebs |
| Frozen! | Encases players in frost ice with Slowness |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Open the config screen via ModMenu, or edit `config/randomevents.json` directly.

| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| Event Interval | 60s | Time between events (10–600s) |
| Announce Events | true | Broadcast event name to all players |
| Enable Good Events | true | Allow good events to trigger |
| Enable Bad Events | true | Allow bad events to trigger |

---

## 🎮 Commands

All commands require operator permission (level 2).

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/re trigger` | Trigger a random event immediately |
| `/re fire <name>` | Trigger a specific event by name |
| `/re list` | List all available events |
| `/re timer` | Show time until the next event |
| `/re config reload` | Reload config from file |

---

## 📦 Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
|-------------|---------|
| Minecraft | 1.21.11 |
| Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.18.0 |
| Fabric API | 0.141.1+ |
| YACL *(optional)* | 3.8.2+ |
| ModMenu *(optional)* | 17.0.0+ |

> **Server-side required.** Client installation is optional — installing the client mod adds the countdown HUD and in-game config screen.

---

## 🌐 Translation

Currently available in:
- 🇬🇧 English
- 🇹🇼 Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)
- 🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese (简体中文)

Want to add your language? Contributions are welcome!
